comment: Reading script for wake-word NEGATIVE data collection. kind=read: normal sentences in the user's two languages (phonetically diverse + assistant-style commands, since those surround real wakes). kind=trap: hard negatives — phonetic near-misses of 'Hey Jarvis' the model must learn to REJECT. Traps must NEVER contain the wake phrase itself.
